tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (oṃ)༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsnyen yig gsal ba mkha' spyod dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༈/na mo gu ru badz+ra yo ga
(oṃ)༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsnyen yig gsal ba mkha' spyod dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༈/na mo gu ru badz+ra yo ga

tei:div.tei:p: (oṃ)༄༅// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsnyen yig gsal ba mkha' spyod dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi nī maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ nges gsang rgya chen gdams pa'i bang mdzod can// mtha' yas rgyal ba kun dngos dkyil 'khor gtso// 'gro 'dren rdo rje slob dpon gzugs gzhan du// ngur smrig gar bsgyur drin can bla ma mchod// zhes pa mi shes mgo yon gyi mchod brjod sbyar nas/ 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos kyi nang tshan mchog bsgrub dmar mo skor gsum gyi gtso mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs/ grol 'khrid zhal bzhes sogs thob nas/ lam bsgom par byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas bsnyen pa/ bsgrub pa/ las sbyor rnams la 'jug par 'dod na/ de gsum po'ang re re nas rim bzhin go rim ma log par nyams su len pa las/ gsum po stabs gcig tu byed pa min la/ de'i phyir dang po bsnyen pa bya tshul la mkhas grub kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen yig kha shas 'dug pas/ bdag gis 'di bris pa la rnam pa gcig tu dgos pa med kyang*/ rmongs pa la rmongs pas sbyar ba'i bsnyen yig byung na gti thug rigs mthun gyi go sla khyad zhig yong 'dra'am bsams nas bkod 'dis dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la thag 'dogs mi yong la che/ mdo rgyud kyi bshad bshad 'grig 'grig mang po'i lung 'dren yin yin mang po bkod pa la ni bdag la mthong thos sbyangs yon med pa dang*/ bsgom yon ni le lo'i ngang du dus 'das pas ci la yong*/ bsnyen pa dngos la sbyor ba grabs bshams dang*/ bsnyen pa la 'jug pa dngos/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po la bsnyen pa grub ring 'phos skyas sogs mi dgos pa'i gnas khang 'khos su phebs pa/ bar chad kyi rkyen mthong thos sogs kyis dben par/ gnam rgyan yol ba sogs kyis 'byor na mdzes par byas/

phyogs la nges pa yod par ma mthong yang*/ bde na nub nas shar gzigs su bla ma yi dam chos srung gi bris 'bur gyi rten bshams pa'i mdun du bang rim can gyi stegs la rnal 'byor ma mtshon pa'i yi dam chos srung gi mchod gtor gang dgos rgyas par bshams/ de'i 'og gi bang rim la nyer spyod sogs ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa bshams shing dang ba 'dren par bya/ rang la 'khos 'byor med na rnal 'byor ma'i mchod gtor zlum po che ba pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba zhig ni nges par dgos la/ 'byor ldan spros bcas kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i mi snyogs sting skyer rang gis mdzad gzhan 'dra/ gang ltar mchod gtor sogs shar gzigs kyi dbang du byas na zhal sprod kyi tshul du nub phyogs par sa dkar gyi rgya gram g.yung drung gang 'os bris pa'i khar mi myags pa'i phyir du rtswa'am lcug ma phra mo bkram pa'i khar rang gi stan srab 'thug ji ltar 'os pa gting*/ mtshams 'og tu grogs theb 'khrol/ yo byad gang dgos/ 'phrod rten gyi sman pa sogs thebs mi lcog pa sogs mtshams khongs su sla dgos rigs rnams mig 'og tu chud par byas/ don la rkyen theg phyin gang dam pa rang blo bde/ rang gi mdun du zhogs re bzhin myang ba dang*/ gtor ma la sgron rgyu'i nang mchod bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa yang bshams/ de nas gza' tshes legs pa'i srod thun nas 'dzugs pa'i thog mar gnas khang la bla ma'i ljags gul yod na rab/ de min gu gul kyus mas legs par 'dug sgo drung nye 'gyang 'gab tu mtshams tho dkar po zhig bzhag la phyi mtshams bcad de stan la 'dug nas thog ma'i thun gcig po 'di'i mgor/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces lus kyi go cha bcas pa dran par bya/ de nas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ grih+na grin+ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ grih+na pa ya grih+na pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā nā ya ho/ bha ga wan badz+ra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sngags rkang re re dang*/ sdig mdzub bam/ se gol gtog pa gang rigs lag pa g.yon pas bya zhing shar nas g.yon skor gyi lho'i bar/ yang shar lho nas byang shar gyi bar du sngags gong bzhin dang phyag rgya bstan pas bsrung bar bya/ gzhan phyi gtor cha gsum/ bgegs sprod sogs mang mang zhig byed mkhan 'dug kyang rnam rtog mang po'i rjes la rgyug shar ma mdzad/ rtse gcig tu grims te gang dang gang yin pa de ka'i mgo nas ched du brtson 'don byed pa 'di ka byed rgyu nyung la don bzang bas/ da lam yang mngon rtogs nyams len gang yin las byung ba bzhin rtse gcig tu skyabs yul bla ma kun 'dus kyi spyan sngar don dran bzhin skyabs 'gro nyer gcig sems bskyed gsum/ rdor sems bsgoms bzlas kyi yig brgya nyer gcig bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa lhar bskyed nas yo ga shud+dho3haṃ gi bar sogs gong 'og thams cad du dmigs pa khrid kyi skabs ltar blo la 'gro nges byed/ de nas sems 'dzin mi dgos pas/ bzlas dmigs gsal btab rjes ngag bzlas ci tsam 'os pa ci 'gro'i bar du dmigs pa yang yang bskyar zhing*/ res 'ga' sngags kyi sgra grags stong la sems gtod pa dang*/ res 'ga' stong nyid blo 'das kyi lta ba'i ngang nas sngags 'dren pa sogs dmigs pa re mos kyi ma yengs par 'dren pa sogs bzlas pa'i skabs thams cad la 'dra bar chad lhag myur bul sgra che chung gi skyon sogs spang*/ bying rgod rmugs pa rnams lta ba dang bsre nus na ma gtogs spangs te dran 'dzin che bar byed/ bza' btung bshang gci 'dor ba sogs kyi skabs su yang sngags bzla ba spangs te ngag ma shor ba shin tu nas gal che/ mtshams rogs 'dra ma byung ba'i skabs su blos mi 'khyud pa'i mi ldang dka' med byung na rang nyid sprul gzhi'i rnal 'byor mar gsal btab/

de'i thugs ka nas mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi rnam par rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa gcig tu bsgoms nas ldang rjes/ slar sprul gzhi de ka'i thugs kar thugs thim par bsgoms nas gnas mal du 'dug nas ngag shor ba la nyes pa chung zhes bdag rang gi bla ma drin can des gsung ngo*// ngag bzlas tshar rjes/ yid bzlas rlung 'khor gcig zhar byung rdzogs rim gnyis/ 'ja' lus dang*/ stong pa bsgrub pa/ bsam mi khyab thun mong min pas thun bsdus rjes 'od gsal la blo gnas tshad bzhag slar thun mtshams kyi lhar langs te mchod gtor la bdud rtsi sgron/ byin gyis brlab pa nas brtsams te/ rnal 'byor ma'i gtor 'bul/ de'i rjes su mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ram chag med kyi gtor bsngo gzhan yod tshe rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi bar du bzhugs shig de'i rjes su gzhi bdag gtor bsngo sogs dang mthar brtan bzhugs/ gshegs gsol/ bsngo smon bkra shis kyi bar du bgyid 'os mtha' dag grub rjes/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bskyed rdzogs gang dang 'brel ba byed kyang de'i ngang du nyal lo// ༈ 1 /sang zhogs tho rangs snga bar mdang nyal ba'i bskyed rdzogs gang yin de dang 'brel ba'i ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs te bdud rtsi myang ba'i rnal 'byor byed pa 'di thor thun thams cad la 'dra/ de nas bla ma'i gsol 'debs sogs cung zad byas rjes/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdor sems/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsdus pa/ bskyed rim/ ngag bzlas ci 'grub/ yid bzlas rlung 'khor gcig bsam mi khyab thun mong gi thun bsdus bsngo smon byas te nyi ma 'char gong thun grol/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dran par byed/ 2 nyi dros nas zhogs thun btsugs te/ mdang nub kyi srod thun dang 'dra bar/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ rdor sems/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa/ bskyed rim/ ngag bzlas ci 'gro/

yid bzlas/ rdzogs rim chung ba gnyis mtshams 'dir 'khrid thob cing bsgoms par spro na dbu ma kha dbye/ de'i rjes su lte ba'i pad+mor rlung lnga'i ti la ka zhes pa'i don gyi/ rlung dbu mar bsdu ba dang*/ bsdus nas bsgom pa'i tshul gnyis zhes bshad pa ltar thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rlung sbyang ba gnyis kyang bsgoms/ de nas rlung lus dang*/ sems la gnas pa gnyis bsgoms pa'i rjes su/ bsam mi khyab thun mong min pas thun bsdus la/ nyin gung spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dran pa dang*/ zas kyi rnal 'byor sogs byas te ngal gso/ 3 phyed yol nas dgong thun la zhugs te/ skyabs sems/ rdor sems/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsdus pa/ bskyed rim/ ngag bzlas ci 'gro/ yid bzlas/ bsam mi khyab thun mong gis bsdus te nyi mtshams la grol ba'i rjes su rang gi chag med kyi nyams len gang yod byas/ mun mtshams su gtor ma bsngo ba'i rim pa sogs kyang bya zhing rjes chog gi bar gong du brjod pa bzhin bya/ 4 mun yol nas srod thun btsugs te/ dgong thun ltar byed tshul 'dra/ mdor na thor thun/ dgong thun/ srod thun gyi thugs dam 'dra/ zhogs thun khrid dang rjes 'brel bsgom tshul gong ltar yin/ de ltar thun bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len tshul de bzhin yin la/ thun mtshams rnams su dpe ltas 'dra cung zad kyis mtshon chos ldan du 'gyur ba'i bgyi ba phran bu ma gtogs/ dge sbyor 'phel 'phel mo'i chos sems rgyab gyen 'og 'gyu'i ngang nas ca col mang po ni thugs dam dngos la gnod cing*/ rlung ldang ba las med pas lta ba 'dra bskyang rgyu e yong gzigs/ 'di ni khrid dang rjes 'brel gyi dbang du byas te bkod pa yin la/ bskyed rim bzlas pa kher rkyang gi bsnyen pa byed par 'dod kyang*/ thor thun lta bur yid bzlas tsam ma gtogs rdzogs rim rlung sbyor rnams bzhag ste sngags kyi grangs bsags pas khyab/

skyabs 'gro dang yig brgya'i grangs kyang rgyas bsdus la nges pa med na'ang*/ nyung mtha' thun rer bdun nam bcu gcig re gtong*/ gtor bsngo dgong thun gsham du bsngos pa des 'thus na'ang*/ 'byor zhing nus na thun bzhi ka'i rjes su rje btsun ma rang gi gtor 'bul re grub na legs la/ rje btsun ma'i gtor 'bul ngag 'don tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bdag 'jug gi gsham na yod pa'i dgongs pa 'di bzhin yin te/ gtor ma la bdud rtsi sgron/ oṃ sum+bha nis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga rnams bkol zhing zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho ho hrīḥlan gsum brjod cing phyag rgya ston/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma chos skyong dang 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka la ma ye s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ gsum ma'i gsham du/ oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa bdun gyis 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ gyi sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'thor/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' gro ma// nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// sogs dang*/ lha mo tshad ma sogs kyi 'dod gsol smon lam brjod cing 'bul lo// de ltar brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas tshul de lta bus oṃ gsum ma bzhi 'bum/

bzhi khri/ bzhi stong*/ bzhi brgya bgrangs te dus kyi bsnyen pa 'bring po'i dbang du byas/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa'i tha snyad ni byung dogs ma dgos pas bsnyen mdzad kyang g.yeng ba tsam las med/ de ltar bsnyen pa rdzogs nas/ sbyin sreg shes shing grub na/ 'grub pa'i kha stabs byung na khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i yi ger gsal bar yod pas de bzhin du nyams su len cing mtshams khong de khar grub par byed/ de ltar mtshams khongs su skra sen mi 'breg kha lag mi bkru/ gos stan mi sprug mi gsar dang mthong thos mi byed/ sgrib gdon can gyi rdzas nang du mi len pa sogs/ spyi 'gro'i dam tshig rnams kyang bsrung ba la 'bad dgos te/ dam nyams dang mthong len sgra thos pa sogs byung na dngos grub mi yong*/ sdig can dang byung na dmyal bar skye zhes pa sogs 'dug pas mtshon nyes dmigs rnams la hol spyod ma mdzad par spang blang byed pa gal che zhing*/ deng sang sa skya pa'i dge bshes sku yon che ba'i gras su bzhugs pa 'ga' zhig bzlas pa'i rjes su phreng ba mgo la bzhag 'dod gsol byed pa la dngos grub len pa zhes pa'i ming 'dogs kyi 'dug pa 'di rnying ma pa la 'gran zla'am/ lad mo yin par mngon shing*/ de bzhin du 'ga' zhig ni bsnyen bsgrub kyi dbye ba ma shes par bsnyen par rlom nas bsgrub mchod de ka byed rgyun 'dug pa ni ma go ba'am/ yang na chos brgyad kyi ram zlar ḍā dril sbran pa zhig yin pa 'dra snyam pa bdag rang gi ma dag pa'i snang ba la shar ro// rjes mtshams grol ba'i tshe yar ngo lta bu'i gza' tshes dge ba thor thun dkyus bzhin btang*/ zhogs thun bsdus tsam zhig byas/ rjes su gtor bsngo rnams rgyas par byas/ chos skyong gi gtor 'bul sogs kyang dgos pa yod na khang steng du phul/ brtan bzhugs/ gshegs gsol/ dge tshogs rnam mkhyen du 'gyur ba'i bsngo ba smon lam mam/

bkra shis rnams mthar rgyas su byas/ mtshams tho bsdus nas/ grogs dam tshig pa sogs dang rim gyis 'phrad cing*/ dus gnas kun tu yang bla ma'i mos gus dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs bzlas brjod dang ma 'khon pa bsnyen rgyun ma chad par brtson na byin rlabs rang gi skal ba dang mtshams par yong nges/ sku na yar yar phebs nas/ thugs dam mar mar song na bla ma dkon mchog gsum thugs khrel yong bas gzab mdzod zhu ba yin/ de ltar grangs kyi bsnyen pa rab 'bru 'bum sogs dang*/ mthar yang bzhi 'bum sogs grub nas/ gnyis pa bsgrub pa la 'jug par spro na/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gsum la mchod pa g.yon bskor du sgor mchod/ mdun du mchod gtor bshams pa rnams ma 'khrul bar bya zhing*/ rang gi 'khos 'byor dang bstun pa'i las slar ma song ba bya/ de nas sngar bzhin mtshams dam par bcad/ srod thun nas sgrub mchod btsugs te/ bdag 'jug gi yi ge zhwa lu pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ grol mchog tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa/ blo la gang 'bab bzhin nyams su len te/ thun re re la sngon 'gro nas/ rjes chog gi bar yin te/ thun bzhir bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum bskyed/ bdag 'jug gtor 'bul dang*/ tshogs mchod thun bzhi ka la 'grub na dam tshig nyams chag gi gsos su shin tu 'gyur/ min na'am thun gcig tshogs dang 'brel ba nges par byed cing bdag bskyed kyang thun gang rung gcig la khrid kyi rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar bsgoms zhing*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa dang*/ bsam mi khyab thun mong min pa gnyis kyang thun rer chag med byed/ bzlas pa'i skabs bdag bskyed/ bum bskyed gnyis bzlas pa mang nyung cha 'dra tsam dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs su bdag mdun spro bsdu byas te bzlas pa ci 'gro byed/ tshar chen sogs kyi bdag 'jug na/ mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa dmigs gsal ma gsungs kyang*/

mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi khrid yig chen mor mdun bskyed dang spro bsdu bya zhing zhes pa'i tha snyad kyis kyang shes par nus pas grol mchog rje'i dkyil chog ltar mdun bskyed kyi ngag 'don dang dmigs bskor sbyar te nyams su len tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas bzlas pa khyon sgril bzhi 'bum tsam ma song gi bar du brtson par nyams su blangs pas sgrub pa zhes pa'i go don tshang ba 'dra/ gsum pa las sbyor la lam bsgom pa'i gang zag rab zag bcas kyi lus zag med du gyur nas mkha' spyod kyi gnas su bgrod/ 'bring laṅka li yi las sbyor la brten nas 'grub pa/ tha mas 'chi ka bar do skye ba brgyud nas 'grub pa zhes gsungs 'dug pas/ rab kyi gang zag skal ldan de 'dra ni mi 'byon/ 'bring laṅka li yi las sbyor ni mi nus/ phal cher gang zag gsum pa de ka'i tshul la zhugs na brtan pas de kar 'jug pa dang*/ bla ma yi dam tha dad med par gsol 'debs nyams len la 'bad 'tshal/ mkha' la spyod pa'i grong khyer 'chi med du// zab bral 'ja' 'od lus kyis 'gro 'dod na// rgyal yum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo rje btsun ma'i// lam 'dir rtse gcig 'bad pas bsgrub par gyis// bskyed rdzogs ma bsgom dam tshig ma bsrung zhing*// rnam g.yeng gnyid dang le lo'i dbang gyur nas// zhing khams de 'drar slebs dogs a cang de// 'jigs rung gshin rje'i grogs kyis khrid dogs mchis// de phyir lam la 'bad pa cher skyes nas// gtan 'dun sgrub ched dal 'byor lus 'di la// mi rtag dran bskul yang yang btang byas nas// rtse gcig sgrub la 'bungs shig skal mnyam tsho// zhes pa 'di yang drin can bla ma zhwa lu pa chen po'i zhabs rdul gtsug gis brten cing*/ gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i nyam chung rgyal khams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis sbyar pa'o// ༈ /

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi 'pho ba byed tshul bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so// ༈ /na mo badz+ra yo gi nī ye/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub pa'i gang zag rab bsgom bzlas la brten nas 'grub/ 'bring bsnyen sgrub las gsum la brten nas 'grub/ tha mas 'chi kha 'pho ba'i gdams ngag la brten nas 'grub pa dang gsum las/ 'dir phyi ma bshad par bya ste/ dang po sbyor ba 'pho ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro nas/ bsam mi khyab kyi ngang nas rnal 'byor ma'i skur ldang ba'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin las/ de nas rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar du/ rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po sbub stong*/ sbom phra mda' snyug 'bring po tsam gsal btab pa'i/ dbu ma'i mar sner rang sems gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bcas pa'i ngo bo bam̐ yig dmar po sran ma tsam 'phar ling pa'i rnam pa dang*/ dbu ma'i yar sne spyi bo tshang bug la zugs pa/ skya tha le yod pa'i mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa sogs/ mngon rtogs bzhin gsal gdab pa'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba dang bcas pa la/ gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pas/ bdag 'dzin blo yi thongs par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar= /lam mchog 'pho ba 'byong bar= /'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams 'od phung 'ja' tshon gyi rnam par gyur nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim/ de'i thugs kar 'pho 'dod drag pos/ dbu ma'i mar sne'i bam̐ yig la sems gtad de hika zhes brjod pas bam̐ yig de rgyang ste 'phos/ lte bar byung bar bsam/ yang gong bzhin sems drag tu gtad de hika zhes brjod pas snying gar byung*/

yang hika brjod pas mgrin par 'phos/ yang hig zhes brjod pas/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mdzub gang bar rgyang ste thon/ de ma thag ka zhes brjod pas/ dbu ma'i nang du mar bde hri li li bab ste/ snying gar gnas par bsam/ yang rje btsun ma la gsol ba gdab cing*/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig la sems gtad/ hika zhes brjod pas/ spyi bo'i tshangs pa'i bu gar mdzub gang bar rgyang ste thon/ de ma thag ka zhes brjod pas dbu ma'i nang bde hril li li bab ste snying gar gnas par bsam/ yang rje btsun ma la gsol ba gdab cing snying ga'i bam̐ yig sems gtad de hika zhes brjod pas/ mgrin pa sogs su yar 'phro ba dang*/ mar 'bebs pa rnams gong bzhin yang yang sbyangs/ thun gyi mthar/ mdun gyi rje btsun rnal 'byor ma bdag la brtse ba'i tshul gyis 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim/ tshangs bug haṃ yig dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa zhig gi bkag par bsams la/ mkha' spyod du khrid pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam ci shes bya/ de ltar sbyangs pas spyi bo za ba dang tsha ba dang*/ mgo na ba dang*/ rig pa 'pho rgod che ba la sogs pa 'byung ba'i rtags ma byung gi bar 'bad do// ༈ /gnyis pa 'pho ba sngon 'gro gang du sbyang ba'i skabs ltar las/ lus skyil krung bcas pa la/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur gyis brla gnyis kyi rtsa ba nas mar mnan/ dpung pa gnyis yar brgyangs/ mgrin par cung zad bkug ste/ rgal tshig mda' ltar bsrangs/ de nas paṇa chen nā ros/ rlung gi gzhu la sems kyi mda'// hika gi sgra yi rab bsgul bas// rnam par shes pa chos nyid 'das// zhes gsungs pa ltar gong bzhin dbu ma'i mar sne'i bam̐ yig la sems gtad nas/ hika zhes brjod pa dang mnyam du lto ba ri rab la gcar/ 'og rlung drag tu bskum pas/ 'og rlung gis yig bskyod nas rgyang ste lte bar byung bar bsam/ sbyor ba de lta bu'i hika zhes brjod pas snying khar 'phos/

yang hika zhes brjod pas mgrin par 'phos/ de la sems drag tu gtad de/ phaṭa zhes brjod pas skar mda' 'phang ba ltar/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas rgyangs te thon nas/ mdun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i pad+ma'i sbubs su thim pas bde stong dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam la/ brjod bral gyi ngang du bzhag des bde stong dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor ngo 'phrod nas/ mkha' la spyod pa'i dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ro// ༈ /na mo badz+ra yo gi nī/ rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo'i 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ gzhan la 'pho ba 'debs par 'dod na/ phyi dbug chad nang dbug ma chad pa'i bar der/ 'o che ge mo zhes lan gsum bos te/ khyod kyi tshe dang las dang bsod nams kyi 'phen pa gsum zad pas tshe'i dus byas te/ de la 'byung ba cig char du thim pa dang*/ rim gyi thim pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rim gyi thim pa la sogs par srog dang bral ba'o// gnyis pa ni rim gyi thim pa la/ sa khams chu la thim pas lus kyi zung mi thub cing*/ dma' thib thibs su song ba'i snang ba 'byung*/ chu khams me la thim pa kha sna skam/ lce gre phugs su ldog skom dad skye/ me khams rlung la thim pas lus kyi drod yal/ yan lag brkyang bskum byed/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim par gre bar har sgra gig pa 'don cing mig gyen du bzlog de tshe dam pa'i chos nyams su len pa'i gang zag la/ lha dang bla ma la sogs pa'i dag pa'i snang ba sna tshogs nyams la 'char ba dang*/ sdig can dag la/ gshin rje'i pho nya 'jigs su rung ba'i rnam pa sna tshogs kyi snang ba 'char bar 'gyur ro// de nas byang sems thur babs dkar lam shar ba dang*/ rak+ta gyen log dmar lam shar ba zhes pa/ pha las thob pa'i byang sems dkar po ha yig gi tshul du spyi bor gnas pa dbu ma'i nang du thur la bab pas/ de'i rtags su ston nam skya po la zla ba shar ba lta bu dang*/ du ba dang*/

smig rgyu lta bu'i snang ba 'byung ste/ de'i tshe zhe sdang gi rtog pa thams cad 'gag nas/ dgra mi sha shor ba lta bu dang 'phrad kyang zhe sdang gi rtog pa mi skye zhing*/ ma las thob pa'i rak+ta dmar po/ a shad kyi rnam par lte bar gnas pa dbu ma'i nang du gyen la song bas/ nam mkha' sprin dmar gyis khyab pa la nyi ma shar ba lta bu dang srin bu me khyer lta bu'i snang ba 'byung ste/ de'i tshe chags pa'i rtog pa thams cad 'gag nas rang gi nye 'brel dang nor rdzas la sogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang lha'i bu dang bu mos bskor kyang chags pa'i rtogs pa skad cig kyang mi skye bar 'gyur ro// de ltar mi 'gyur ba'i 'khor lo gnyis zhig nas byang sems dkar dmar snying gar 'dres/ rlung sems dbu mar 'dus te/ rnam par shes pa mar me rlung gis mi bskyod pa lta bur gsal lam me gnas/ de tshe gti mug gi rtog pa thams cad 'gag nas sgrib byed ma rig pa 'thug pos kyang sgrib par mi nus pa'i 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku zhes bya ba/ rang byung gi ye shes 'char bar 'gyur bas/ sgom gyi nyams myong yod pa rnams sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa lta bur 'byung bar 'gyur te/ paṇa chen nā ros/ mi rtag g.yar po'i sgyu lus zhig pa'i tshe// sems rtog med chos sku rang sar grol// zung 'jug gi nyams cig de ru skye// de 'dzin pa med pa lhod de zhog /ces gsungs so// 'od gsal de'i ngang du/ ji tsam gnas kyi bar mnyam par bzhag mthar zung 'jug de'i ngang la spyi bo nas 'phos te/ mkha' spyod ma'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro// 'od gsal de ngo ma shes shing sems ma zin na/ gti mug 'dod chags/ zhe sdang gsum rtog pa rim gyis longs khyab byed kyi rlung gis rkyen byas/ rnam shes bu ga dgu gang rung nas 'thon te/ tshe snga ma'i rtogs pa 'gags/ phyi ma'i rtogs pa ma skyes pa'i bar de/ bar do'i yid lus blangs nas zhag bzhi bcu'i bar ci rigs par gnas par 'gyur te/

mdzod las/ sngon dus srid pa'i sha gzugs can// dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu// las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan// rigs mthun lha mig dag pas mthong*// zhes pa ltar/ sngon gyi srid pa'i sha gzugs 'dzin pa'i yid kyi lus can kha dang mig la sogs pa'i dbang po thams cad tshang zhing las dbang las grub pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs dang ldan pas ma'i mngal dang byin rlabs las grub pa'i rdo rje'i gdan ma gtogs/ gzhan ri rab dang khang khyim gang la yang thogs pa med pa bsam pa tsam gyis stong gsum thams cad skad cig tsam la bgrod par nus shing*/ rigs mthun par bar do na gnas pa rnams dang*/ lha'i mig dang ldan zhing*/ las nyon gyi sgrib pa dag pa rnams kyis mthong bar 'gyur la/ nang du khams dkar dmar mi gnas pas phyi rol du nyi ma dang zla ba'i snang ba med/ gdos bcas kyi lus med pas grib ma dang rjes mi 'byung*/ zag bcas kyi mngon shes yod pas gzhan gyi ci bsam shes/ zhag bdun re'i mtshams su 'chi chung re dang bar do'i yid lus re len/ de nas/ mi ldog de ni dri za'o// zhes pa ltar du rnam shes sngar gyi phung po rnying pa la mi ldog par dri za'i mngal gyi skye gnas 'tshol ba'i skabs zhes pa/ skye gnas don du gnyer bas phyogs kun tu rgyug pa la brten nas 'byung ba 'khrugs te/ sa rlung 'khrugs pas ri bo chen po nyil ba dang*/ grum pa dang*/ phrag ri chen po zhig pa'i sgra lta bu dang*/ chu rlung 'khrugs pa rgya mtsho chen po'i rba rlabs gnam du 'phyo ba dang*/ 'khrugs pa dang*/ g.yang sa'i gcong rong du zhugs pa'i sgra lta bu dang*/ me rlung 'khrugs pas/ bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me sgra lta bu dang*/ stong gsum thams cad me 'bar ba'i snang ba dang*/ nags tshal chen po tshigs pa'i sgra lta bu dang*/ rlung gi rlung 'khrugs pas dus mtha'i rlung dmar chen po 'tshubs cing 'khyil ba dang*/ snang srid thams cad bya sgro rlung gis skyod pa lta bur g.yo ba dang*/

de dag gi rang sgra 'brug stong dus gcig la ldir ba'i sgra lta bur thos te/ de dag la 'jigs shing skrag nas skyabs gnas tshol bar bsam pa'i tshe/ dbang dang sdom pa thob pa rnams kyis skyabs gnas bla ma dang rdo rje slob dpon dran/ des bstan pa'i yi dam gyi lha dran/ lha de yi mtshan las gras nas btags pa'i gsang mtshan gyi ming nas dran/ de la brten nas rang nyid goms pa'i dbang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnam rol du dran/ de'i tshe dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'dus nas/ mchod pa'i sprin gyis phung pos gtibs shing*/ gsang mtshan gyi ming nas 'bod cing lung bstan no// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par 'gyur te/ mkha' 'gro kun spyod las/ 'chi zhes bya ba rnam rtog yin// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid// ces gsungs so// tha mal pa rnams kyi skyabs gnas dang yib pa tsam nas/ nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi rang gzugs dkar nag dmar gsum gyi rang gzugs/ g.yang sa gcong rong chen po nyams nga ba gsum mthong ste/ de dag tu ltung ba'i dogs pa dang*/ de dang mtshungs par rnam byang gi lam/ 'od kha dog dkar po 'char ba dang*/ sdong dum dang*/ sa phug dang*/ ngang pas brgyan pa'i mtsho gling dang*/ ba glang gis brgyan pa'i mtsho gling dang*/ rtas brgyan pa'i mtsho gling dang*/ khang bzang dang*/ lha'i gzhal med khang la sogs pa sna tshogs pa mthong ste/ de dag gang du phyin pa dang*/ zhugs pa byung na skye gnas yin te/ de'ang 'od nag po gsal zhing de la chags na dmyal ba/ ser po yi dwags/ dkar po dud 'gro/ dmar po lha/ ljang gu lha ma yin/ sna tshogs mi yis skye gnas/ phyi'i skye gnas la yang ngang pas brgyan pa'i mtsho gling du phyin pa shar lus 'phags po/ ba glang gi brgyan pa'i mtsho gling du phyin na nub ba glang spyod/ rtas brgyan pa'i mtsho gling du byin na byang sgra mi snyan/ khang bzang du phyin na lho 'dzam bu gling du skye'o// lha'i gzhal med khang du zhugs na/

lha gnas dang*/ sdong dum dang*/ sa phugs su yibs pa dang zhugs na yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gro/ lcags khang du zhugs na dmyal ba'i skye gnas/ de de dag gi gnas skabs su yang gnas la nges pa med pa/ grogs la nges pa med pa/ bya byed la yang nges pa med pa/ zas gos la yang nges pa med pa/ rnam shes kyi 'char sgo la yang nges pa med pa sogs/ ma nges pa'i rtags drug gis g.yengs shing sdug bsngal bar 'gyur/ de'i dus su skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum dran pa'i sgo nas gsol ba btab na/ skye gnas ngan pa 'gags nas bzang por skye zhing chos dang 'phrad par 'gyur ro// de ltar bar do'i gdams pa nyams 'og tu chud par byas nas/ mtshams sbyor 'pho ba'i gdams ngag la 'bad par bya dgos te/ mkha' 'gro ma kun tu rtog pa'i rgyud las/ rnam shes rlung la zhon nas ni// 'og gi lam nas 'phos gyur na// chos la goms pa'i gang zag kyang*// ngan 'gro dag tu skye bar 'gyur// rnam shes rlung dang bsdong nas 'og lam gnyis lte ba gsum gang rung nas 'phos na/ re zhig ngan song gsum po gang rung du 'phen no// de bzhin du sdig chen yang 'pho bas mtshams sbyar spyi bor 'phos pas mtho ris gsum po gang rung skye bar 'gyur na gzhan rnams lta ci smos te/ rgyud las/ rnam shes rlung la zhon nas ni// steng gi lam la 'phos gyur na// sdig la gom pa'i gang zag kyang*// mtho ris dag tu skye bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// des phan yon dang nyes dmigs bstan nas/ de nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su/ bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pas lam mer bzhugs shing de dag gi sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas skyabs gnas kun gyi ngo bor mos nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces brjod la skyabs 'gro ci nus bya/ mthar bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la skyabs gsol gyi tshig brjod nas/

skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas spyi bo nas thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum dang 'dres shing rgyud byin gyis rlabs par mos pa mdzod/ de ltar skyabs su song nas/ sems bskyed pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bdag gi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bya/ de'i ched du dag pa mkha' spyod du 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyams su blang bar bya'o// zhes sems bskyed de/ khyed rang gi lus de nyid/ tha mal pa ma yin par skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par sing dar dmar po'i gur phub pa lta bur lam gyis gyur pa'i spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar du rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po sbub stong*/ sbom phra mda' snyug 'bring po tsam pa'i mar snar/ sgo nga'i sbub lta bu'i zlum po'i nang du/ sems kyi rten bam̐ yig dmar po sran ma'i rdog po tsam 'phar ling nge ba/ yar sne spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar zug pa/ skar khung gsal ba ltar skya tha le yod pa'i steng gi bar snang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar po'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs pa mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug mthur du 'phyang nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la babs cing*/

'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis/ g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pa'i gru mo'i khug na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab cing gzi 'od 'bar ba/ de'i mtha' skor du/ paṇa chen nā ro ta pa/ grub chen pham thing pa sku mched/ mnga' bdag lo chen rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la sogs pa brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba'o// de rnams kyang chos nyid bde ba chen po'i ngang du ro gcig kyang chos can gyi mdangs tha dad du shar ba ste/ gang la gang 'dul gyi skur bstan pa/ bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs pa'i mos pa bya/ de dag la lus sems 'dun ma rtse gcig tu gtad de gdung shug drag po'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod zhes dang*/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas gsol ba btab la/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams 'od phung bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim/ de'i thugs kar 'pho 'dod drag pos/ dbu ma'i mar sne'i bam̐ yig la dmigs nas hika zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ yar sor rdo 'phang ba ltar lte ba/ snying kha/ mgrin pa rnams su rim pa bzhin du 'phos/ de la sems drag tu gtad nas phaṭa/ zhes brjod pas/ the tshom med par rgyang ste spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas thon/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i pad+ma'i sbubs su thog med du zhugs nas/

bde stong dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres song snyam du mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/ gong gi dmigs pa dang ldan pas skra nas dal bus yang yang 'then/ hika lan gsum gsum dang*/ phaṭa sgra drag po gcig gis 'phangs te/ bsgrub bya'i sems/ rnal 'byor ma'i thugs/ rang sems gsum/ brjod bral bde ba chen po'i ngang du khrug ste bsres la/ de'i ngo bo la blta zhing*/ dmigs med kyi ngang du yun ring bzhag cing*/ stong gsal de'i rang mdangs ma shor ba'i sgo nas smon lam rnam par dag pa btab pa ni/ dal 'byor gru chen sogs kyi gsang ba bde stong dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor ma ngo 'phrod pa'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa zhes bya'o// de ltar 'pho ba btab pa'i thob byed 'bras bu la/ gsum las/ rab rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ 'bring mkha' la spyod pa'i rig 'dzin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi nam mkha' la rgyu zhing spyod yul shin tu mdzes shing lo bcu drug lon pa'i cha lugs can/ tshe nyi zla gnas kyi bar thub pa/ ci bsam longs spyod nam mkha' las 'byung ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro zhing*/ sprul pa'i sku la chos nyan pa dang*/ tha ma'ang mtho ris gsum po gang rung du skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes pa 'di rje btsun byams pa chos legs kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar/ bar do'i gdams ngag cung zad gcig gis mtshams sbyar te/ gzhan la brtse ba'i bsam pas yul gtsang stod kyi btsun pa blo gsal gyis zhwa lung mtsho kha'i ri khrod du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
